propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock time assertions in tests/** cause CI flake under runner contention and must be detected and blocked at code-review time with teaching message naming both valid escapes: '# timing: hang-guard — <reason>' marker or '@pytest.mark.skipif(CI)' guard.

Migration of two sites from timing assertions to counting proxies: test_config_perf.py:201 spies cfg._ordered_layers with regression detection; test_enrich_drain.py:261 counts Q.pending_enrichment probes.
Remaining 11 in-scope sites must be marked with reasoned hang-guard markers and the detector must pass cleanly over the tree at landing.

Detector must reject bare '@pytest.mark.benchmark' as insufficient escape, accept both hang-guard comment marker and skipif-CI guard independently, and preserve self-exclusion for its own fixture file via EXCLUDED_FILES.
